Appearance

Wiry man in his early 50s, graying hair slicked back, sharp blue eyes. Wears finely tailored clothes in muted, practical colors.

What We Know

Guildmaster of the Highreach Merchants Guild. Runs a tight operation and demands professionalism. Known for his formal, detached manner.

First Impressions

Cold, calculated, and never rattled — not someone who suffers fools.

Interactions

  • Hired the party for a private job — party took his gold and outplayed him
  • Small story about him buried in the back of the newspaper
  • Arrived after the bandit ambush — offered the party a new deal to clear the mines
